section: Hero: the role title, summary and location on a sand band
fields: Title (the page title at the top of the editor)
Role box, below the title: Summary
notes: The Summary is the short paragraph under the title. It is also shown on the vacancy card and as the lead paragraph when the role opens in a panel on the Careers page.
The Location is the small line under the summary and on the vacancy card, for example London, hybrid.
The coral full stop after the title is added for you.

section: Role description: a narrow column of text
fields: The main editor (the full role description)
notes: Use headings for About the role, What you will do, About you and What we offer, and lists for the details.
The same text is used on this page and in the panel on the Careers page.

section: All current vacancies link, Apply button and questions link
notes: The Apply button takes the visitor to the application form on the Careers page with the role already filled in.
The Get in touch link opens the Contact page.
